title: Europe and China - a changing relationship in a changing world
body:
Keynote speech by Dr Sabine Mauderer, First Deputy Governor of the Deutsche Bundesbank, at the 12th China Day, organised by dfv Euro Finance Group GmbH, Frankfurt am Main, 16 November 2026.
